title: Autonomous Robot Development - Stereo Vision & Path Planning
description: Developed and implemented CSI stereo camera driver for depth sensing and path planning algorithms for autonomous robots using ROS and C++.
skills: ROS, C++, Computer Vision, Path Planning, Stereo Vision, Linux, Robotics

body.raw:
## Overview

(Jun 2021)

Development and implementation of critical perception and navigation systems for an autonomous robot platform, including stereo vision depth sensing and intelligent path planning.

## Key Components

### Stereo Camera Driver
- **CSI Stereo Camera Integration**: Developed custom driver for CSI (Camera Serial Interface) stereo camera
- **Depth Estimation**: Implemented algorithms to extract depth information from stereo pairs
- **Real-time Processing**: Optimized for real-time performance in robotic systems

### Path Planning System
- **Algorithm Development**: Implemented path planning algorithms for autonomous navigation
- **Obstacle Avoidance**: Integration with depth sensing for dynamic obstacle detection
- **Trajectory Generation**: Computed optimal paths for robot movement

## Technical Implementation

### Hardware Integration
- CSI Stereo Camera module
- Integration with ROS middleware
- Real-time sensor data processing

### Software Architecture
- ROS-based system design for modularity and scalability
- C++ implementation for performance-critical components
- Depth processing pipeline
- Path planning algorithms

## Technology Stack

- **ROS (Robot Operating System)**: Framework for sensor and algorithm coordination
- **C++**: High-performance implementation
- **Computer Vision**: Stereo vision and depth processing
- **Linux**: Development and deployment environment
- **Robotics**: Autonomous systems principles

## Impact

Enabled autonomous robots to perceive their environment through stereo vision and navigate intelligently using computed path planning, forming the foundation for autonomous navigation capabilities.
